'''Rubblet''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Cobbledon]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Rubblet does everything in slow mode, whether it's blinking or walking. But firing off an Azure Flare? That's a different story entirely."

Rubblet is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, brown lizard with blue spikes on its tail, purple claws, and bright blue eyes with darker blue sclera and white pupils. It has a cream underbelly and darker brown accents on its feet, head, and tail.

Rubblet's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces brown with gray, and blue/purple becomes orange/red.

== Evolution Trial ==
Rubblet's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars. To evolve it into [[Cobbledon]] you need to complete the following task:
* Kill 300 Zobos while clearing stages. Show them the power of Azure Flare!

==Strategy==
[[File:Rubblet Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Rubblet's attack range]]
A basic Rock tank, it provides slightly more multi-lane clear than the [[Gibber]] line, so its used to help cover more lanes, while [[Gibber]] line is used for longer single range clear due to how short the [[Rubblet]] line range is. 
{{clear|left}}
